detailed_findings.finding: Using the floor inequality m <= p/4 < m+1 and subtracting 1 from the right inequality correctly yields m > p/4 - 1.
Combining n >= m with m > p/4 - 1 by transitivity is valid and completes the argument.

reason: The proof is correct and complete: it applies the defining inequality for m = floor(p/4), derives m > p/4 - 1 from p/4 < m + 1, and combines this with n >= m to conclude n > p/4 - 1. It matches the lemma statement and serves the intended bridge in the root theorem from an integral lower bound to the required strict real inequality.
